The clinic advocates a holistic approach to medicine, treating both body and mind. (該診所倡導整體醫療方法，同時治療身體和心靈。)
The historical castle was built securely on a small river holm, protecting it from sudden land assaults. (這座歷史悠久的城堡被牢固地建造在一個河流小島上，使其免受突如其來的陸地襲擊。)
The modern art exhibition paid homage to the pioneering cubist works of Pablo Picasso. (這場現代藝術展向巴布羅·畢卡索開創性的立體主義作品致敬。)

meaning: 樸素的；平淡無奇的；（美）相貌平平的
example: The restaurant was decorated in a homely style, making customers feel as though they were dining in their own kitchens. (這家餐廳裝潢風格樸素溫馨，讓顧客感覺彷彿在自家廚房用餐一樣。)

meaning: 有返回原處本能的；導引的
example: Homing pigeons possess an extraordinary biological navigation ability to find their way across thousands of miles. (信鴿具有非凡的生物導航能力，能在數千英哩之外找到回家的路。)

The study examines the biological and social aspects of homosexuality. (這項研究探討了同性戀的生物與社會層面。)
The honeybee functions as a critical ecological pollinator, supporting the reproductive cycles of diverse wild angiosperms. (蜜蜂充當關鍵的生態授粉者，支持著多種野生被子植物的繁殖週期。)
The Hopewell culture is renowned for constructing monumental earthworks and maintaining vast trade networks. (霍普威爾文化以建造宏偉的土木工程遺跡和維持廣大的貿易網而聞名。)
The industrial agricultural processing plant utilized a massive metal hopper to feed grain into the milling machine. (工業農業加工廠利用一個巨大的金屬漏斗，將穀物餵入磨粉機中。)
The endocrine organs secrete volatile chemical compounds that regulate systematic hormonal variations inside mammals. (內分泌器官會分泌化學訊息分子，調節哺乳動物體內的荷爾蒙變化。)
The park rangers patrolled the rugged terrain of the national park on horseback to minimize environmental impact. (公園巡邏員騎在馬背上巡邏國家公園的崎嶇地形，以儘量減少對環境的影響。)
The canyon loop forms a spectacular horseshoe bend carved out by millions of years of river erosion. (河道經過數百萬年的侵蝕，在峽谷中形成壯觀的馬蹄形大彎。)
Early societies practiced small-scale horticulture using hand tools before developing intensive agriculture with plows. (早期社會在發展出使用犁的密集農業之前，先使用手工工具進行小規模的園藝耕作。)
The urban geographer analyzed how the expansion of intercity rail stations boosted the economic fortune of the metropolitan hotelkeeper class. (城市地理學家分析城際鐵路車站的擴建，如何增加大都市旅館業者的經濟收益。)
Wild huckleberry shrubs thrive in the acidic soils of northern temperate forests, providing vital summer food for bears. (野生越橘灌木在北方溫帶森林的酸性土壤中茂盛生長，為熊提供了至關重要的夏季食物。)
Inuit hunters had to huddle inside compacted snow igloos to protect their skin from lethal polar wind gusts. (因紐特獵人不得不擠在緊實的雪屋內，保護皮膚免受致命的極地強風吹襲。)
Advanced artificial intelligence software now generates humanlike responses to complex logical queries. (先進的人工智慧軟體現在能針對複雜的邏輯提問生成類似人類的回應。)
The transition toward naturalism in statuary arts emphasized humanness, capturing realistic body weight and emotion. (雕塑藝術轉向自然主義，強調人性，呈現寫實的人體重量感與情感。)
The productivity of textile weaving multiplied hundredfold following the centralization of mechanical steam power inside factories. (工廠集中使用機械蒸汽動力後，紡織生產力提高了百倍。)
Animal husbandry allows pastoralist groups to sustain constant food resources across arid steppe landscapes. (畜牧業使牧民得以在乾旱的草原地帶持續取得食物來源。)
Before mechanical fanners were invented, farmers hand-crushed agricultural grains to isolate the seed from its dry husk. (在機械風選機被發明之前，農民手工壓碎農業穀物，以將種子從其乾燥的外殼中分離出來。)
The streets of New York City are famous for their constant hustle and bustle. (紐約市的街道以其不斷的繁忙和喧囂而聞名。)

meaning: 水文地理的；水道測量的
example: The government surveyor conducted detailed hydrographic mappings to delineate navigable river channels across midcontinent valleys. (政府測量員進行詳細的水道測繪，以標示大陸中部山谷中可供船隻通行的河道。)

Persistent overirrigation in semiarid zones alters the deep hydrological table, provoking toxic alkali buildup in topsoil. (半乾旱地區長期過度灌溉會改變深層地下水位，導致表土中的有毒鹼分累積。)
Modern soilless agriculture setups utilize balanced hydroponic nutrient fluid channels to accelerate crop maturation phases. (現代的無土農業裝置利用平衡的水耕營養液通道，來加速作物的成熟階段。)

In extreme environmental conditions, some animals enter a state of hyper-awareness to detect hidden predators. (在極端的環境條件下，某些動物會進入一種過度警覺的狀態，以偵測隱蔽的捕食者。)
Certain desert plants possess hypersensitive roots that detect minuscule subsurface moisture fluctuations instantly. (某些沙漠植物的根部極為敏感，能立即偵測地下極微小的水分變化。)
The invention of hypertext allowed web users to navigate seamlessly between interconnected electronic documents. (超文字的發明使網路用戶能夠在互連的電子文件之間進行無縫導覽。)
It is hypocritical of him to lecture others about protecting the environment. (他自己做不到，卻愛對別人說教要保護環境，實在虛偽。)
Astronomers hypothesize that an ancient collision with a proto-planet tilted Uranus drastically on its axis. (天文學家假設，古代與一顆原始行星的撞擊使天王星的自轉軸發生了劇烈傾斜。)
The scientist drafted a hypothetical atmospheric model to simulate how Venus entered a runaway greenhouse cycle. (科學家起草了一個假設的大氣模型，以模擬金星如何進入失控的溫室循環。)

meaning: 北山羊（一種高山野山羊）
example: The alpine ibex possesses specialized rubbery hooves tailored for navigating the most rugged and steep granite cliff faces. (高山北山羊的蹄部具有特殊彈性，適合在最崎嶇陡峭的花崗岩峭壁上行走。)
The ichthyosaur was a highly adapted marine reptile that bore a striking superficial resemblance to modern dolphins. (魚龍是一種高度適應的海洋爬蟲類，外觀上與現代海豚有著驚人的相似之處。)
As spring meltwater seeps through sandstone canyon crevices, it forms a dangling icicle during cold polar nights. (春季融水滲入砂岩峽谷的裂縫後，在寒冷的極地夜晚結成懸垂的冰柱。)
The art history professor analyzed the iconographic elements present in early medieval religious paintings. (藝術史教授分析中世紀早期宗教繪畫中的圖像學元素。)

meaning: 理想主義的、不切實際的
example: The young diplomats brought an idealistic approach to the negotiation table, though veterans warned of pragmatic challenges. (年輕的外交官將理想主義的方法帶到了談判桌上，儘管老手警告說存在務實的挑戰。)
Traditional classical art demanded the strict idealization of aristocratic profiles, rejecting the gritty physical truth of naturalism. (傳統古典藝術要求嚴格理想化貴族的外貌，排斥自然主義對肉身真實樣貌的呈現。)
The puritanical religious sect was ideologically rigid, rejecting the mercantile commercialism of the metropolis. (這個清教徒宗教派別在意識形態上十分僵化，拒絕大都市的商業主義。)
The Ouija board phenomenon is often explained by the ideomotor effect. (碟仙現象通常可以用意念運動效應來解釋。)

meaning: 田園詩般的、安逸舒適的
example: The artists spent the summer working in an idyllic countryside cottage surrounded by rolling wildflower hills. (藝術家們整個夏天都在一個被起伏的野花山丘所環繞、如田園詩般美麗的鄉間小屋中工作。)
The traditional igloo features a domelike structure composed of compacted snow blocks that trap internal body heat. (傳統的雪屋具有由緊實雪塊組成的穹頂狀結構，能鎖住內部的身體熱量。)
Extrusive igneous rocks form when molten lava cools rapidly after breaking through Earth's crust. (當熔融的岩漿突破地球地殼並快速冷卻時，就會形成噴出火成岩。)
The introduction of kerosene lamps vastly enhanced indoor illumination during nineteenth-century nighttime hours. (煤油燈的引入大幅增強了十九世紀夜間時段的室內照明。)
The sequential movement created by cinema projectors provides an illusory impression of smooth physical motion to the audience. (電影放映機呈現連續的影像，使觀眾產生流暢動作的錯覺。)
The teacher used an illustrative example to explain the chemical reaction. (老師用了一個說明性的例子來解釋這個化學反應。)
The talented illustrator spent months creating detailed drawings for the new children's encyclopedia. (這位才華橫溢的插畫家花了數月的時間，為新的兒童百科全書創作詳細的插圖。)
The imagist poets broke away from romanticized flowery descriptions, utilizing precise, stark visual imagery. (意象派詩人打破了浪漫化的華麗描述，利用精確、質樸的視覺意象。)
The imagist poetry movement rejected romanticized generalities, prioritizing clear language and precise visual focus. (意象派詩歌運動拒絕浪漫化的籠統概括，優先考慮清晰的語言與精確的視覺焦點。)
An excessive runoff of nitrogen fertilizers can provoke a severe chemical imbalance, triggering algal blooms in waterways. (氮肥的過量逕流會引發嚴重的化學不平衡，在水路中引發藻類大量增殖。)
Ethologists observe imitative behaviors in young primates, who acquire foraging tools by copying parent models. (行為學家在年輕的靈長類動物中觀察到模仿行為，牠們藉由複製親代模範來獲取覓食工具。)
The modernist choreographer rejected classical routines, warning that simple copying transformed a student into a mere mechanical imitator. (這位現代主義編舞家拒絕古典常規，警告說單純的複製會將學生轉化為一個純粹的機械模仿者。)
The physical immaturity of altricial neonates dictates that parent birds must offer prolonged nestling care. (晚成性幼生尚未發育成熟，因此親鳥必須長時間照顧雛鳥。)
The mechanical output of midwest farmlands multiplied immensely following the historical introduction of the automated reaping system. (歷史上引進自動收割系統後，美國中西部農田的機械化產量大幅增加。)
The physical immersion of clay pots inside waterlogged soil can trigger structural cracking unless protected by a glassy glaze. (陶罐在積水土壤中的物理浸沒會引發結構性龜裂，除非受到玻璃質釉料的保護。)
The behavioral immobility displayed by the camouflaged predatory beetle ensures it remains completely inconspicuous on tree bark faces. (具有偽裝色的掠食性甲蟲保持不動，確保自己在樹皮上完全不易被發現。)
A specialized forest parasite can bypass the biological immunity parameters of host trees, triggering wide vascular chlorosis. (一種特殊的森林寄生蟲能避開宿主樹木的生物防禦機制，引發大範圍的維管束黃化。)
Classical art formulas of strict frontality were treated as an immutable sacred law within ancient Egyptian antiquity dynasties. (古埃及王朝將古典藝術中嚴格正面的構圖法則視為不可變的神聖律法。)
The rugged highland alp terrain served as a severe mercantile impediment, restricting intercity railway line expansions. (崎嶇的高山地形成為嚴重的商業阻礙，限制了城際鐵路線的擴建。)
A deep sense of moral duty can impel individuals to risk their lives to rescue strangers from danger. (強烈的道德責任感能驅使個人冒著生命危險從危難中解救陌生人。)
A sudden shift in animal alertness can signal that a catastrophic tectonic earthquake is about to impend. (動物警覺性突然改變，可能預示著毀滅性的板塊地震即將發生。)
Early mechanical phonographs delivered an imperfect sound reproduction format, carrying chaotic background crackles across cylinders. (早期的機械留聲機音質並不完美，圓柱唱片上還會夾雜混亂的背景爆裂聲。)
Early vaudeville theater formats included character impersonation routines that relied heavily on satiric exaggeration. (早期的綜藝雜耍劇包含模仿角色的橋段，並大量運用諷刺性的誇張手法。)

meaning: 不能滲透的、不受影響的
example: The specialized protective safety gear is entirely impervious to highly corrosive industrial chemical acids. (這種專業的防護安全裝備完全無法被高度腐蝕性的工業化學酸液所滲透。)

The imposition of heavy agricultural taxes by the centralized state provoked intense unrest among ranchers. (中央集權國家強加沉重的農業稅，在牧場主之間引發了強烈的不安。)
Using imprecise measurements in chemical experiments can lead to completely inaccurate and dangerous results. (在化學實驗中使用不精確的測量可能會導致完全不準確且危險的結果。)
Impressionism broke away from rigid naturalistic formulas, choosing instead to capture subjective optical impressions of light. (印象派打破了僵硬的自然主義公式，轉而選擇捕捉光線的主觀光學印象。)
The impressionist movement focused heavily on capturing the fleeting interplay of light and shadow in naturalistic settings. (印象派運動極度專注於捕捉自然主義場景中光與影稍縱即逝的相互作用。)
The impressionistic movement prioritized the fleeting play of light, rejecting the rigid outlines of classical naturalism. (印象派運動重視光影稍縱即逝的變化，揚棄古典自然主義僵硬的輪廓。)
Fossilized leaf imprints provide paleobotanists with information about the canopy density of prehistoric forests. (葉片化石的印記為古植物學家提供了關於史前森林樹冠密度的資訊。)
Vaudeville actors relied on physical improvisation to adjust their comic routines when facing disruptive urban audiences. (綜藝雜耍演員仰賴肢體即興表演，在面對吵鬧的城市觀眾時調整喜劇段子。)
The glassmaker added specific metallic minerals to clear silicate sand to neutralize any organic iron impurity. (玻璃工匠在透明的矽酸鹽砂中加入特定金屬礦物，以中和其中的有機鐵雜質。)
Winter metabolic inactivity allows small burrowing mammals to conserve energy inside frozen tundra biomes. (冬季新陳代謝活動降低，使小型穴居哺乳動物能在冰凍的凍原生態系中節省能量。)
The agricultural inadequacy of the meager steppe harvest forced nomadic pastoralists to drive livestock further afield. (大草原收成微薄，無法滿足農業需求，迫使游牧牧民將牲畜趕往更遠的地方。)
The research facility was inadequately funded, which severely limited the scope of its clinical trials. (該研究設施資金不足，這嚴重限制了其臨床試驗的範圍。)
The Inca engineered massive highland agricultural terrace systems that successfully resisted severe soil erosion. (印加人設計並建造大型高地農業梯田，成功抵禦嚴重的土壤侵蝕。)
The stellar coma expanding around the comet's core contains volatile gases glowing with an incandescent light under solar rays. (彗核周圍膨脹的彗髮含有揮發性氣體，在陽光照射下發出白熾的光芒。)
The compromised computer security system was entirely incapable of blocking the advanced cyber assault. (這個被攻破的電腦安全系統完全沒有能力阻擋高階的網路攻擊。)
The accident managed to incapacitate the athlete for the entire season. (這場事故使該運動員整個賽季都喪失了參賽能力。)
From its inception, the mercantile trading guild worked legally to centralize urban monopolies and regulate manufacturing taxes. (自創立之初，這個商業公會便依法致力於集中城市的壟斷權並規範製造業稅收。)
Tidal waves pounded incessantly against the rugged granite seashore, carving out deep erosion gullies. (海潮不斷拍打崎嶇的花崗岩海岸，侵蝕出深深的沖溝。)
Ancient craftspeople would utilize sharp bone styluses to incise dynamic geometric bands into damp earthenware pottery. (古代工匠會用鋒利的骨製刻針，在潮濕的陶器上刻出富有動感的幾何紋帶。)
An amber inclusion, such as a trapped prehistoric insect, preserves exceptional anatomical detail for fossil study. (琥珀內含物（例如被困住的史前昆蟲）為化石研究保存了極佳的解剖細節。)
The organic manuscript remnants were incompletely preserved inside the waterlogged limestone crevice. (這些有機質手稿殘餘未能完整保存於積水的石灰岩裂縫中。)
Before linguists cracked the Rosetta Stone, ancient Egyptian hieroglyphic wall inscriptions were entirely incomprehensible. (語言學家破解羅塞塔石碑之前，古埃及象形文字的壁面銘文完全無法理解。)

The Earth's mantle sits beneath the crust and consists of semi-solid rock that flows via convection currents. (地球的地函位於地殼下方，由透過對流緩慢流動的半固體岩石組成。)
Agriculturalist tribes ground wild plant tubers and combined the remnants with animal manure to generate rich topsoil nutrients. (農耕部落將野生植物塊莖磨碎，與動物糞肥混合，製成肥沃的表土。)
The expansion of maritime empires depended on advanced watercraft fabrication and expert navigational tools. (海洋帝國的擴張有賴先進的造船技術與專業航海儀器。)

meaning: 栗色；褐紅色；使孤立流落
example: The artisan utilized ground iron oxide minerals to produce a deep maroon pigment glaze for finishing the earthenware pot. (工匠將磨碎的氧化鐵礦物製成深栗色釉料，用來裝飾陶罐。)
Archaeologists found smashed animal skeletons, indicating Paleolithic hominids used percussion tools to extract dense bone marrow. (考古學家發現遭敲碎的動物骨骼，顯示舊石器時代的人科動物曾使用敲擊工具取出緻密的骨髓。)
Robotic rovers analyze Martian soil to search for geological evidence of ancient liquid surface water. (機器人探測車分析火星土壤，以尋找古代液態地表水存在的地質證據。)

meaning: 微波激射器（微波放大設備）
example: Astronomers utilize a highly sensitive maser amplifier to record distant radio emissions from interstellar nebulae. (天文學家利用高靈敏度的微波激射器，記錄來自星際星雲的遙遠無線電波。)
The ancestral pueblo people were masters of stone masonry, erecting durable multistory dwellings inside secure sandstone alcoves. (祖先普韋布洛人精於石造建築，在安全的砂岩凹穴中建造堅固的多層住宅。)
The Mayan mathematician class independently formulated the concept of zero long before its adoption elsewhere. (其他地方採用零的概念很久以前，馬雅數學家階層便已獨立發展出零的概念。)
The young couple exchanged traditional vows of sacred matrimony during a peaceful seaside ceremony. (這對年輕夫婦在寧靜的海邊儀式中交換婚姻的神聖誓言。)
Paleontologists meticulously cleared the shale mineral matrix surrounding the fragile transitional finch skeleton. (古生物學家細心地清除了包裹著脆弱過渡期雀鳥骨骼的頁岩礦物基質。)
The stern matron administered the boarding school's dormitory with rigid adherence to the institutional rules. (嚴厲的女主管一絲不苟地遵守校規，管理寄宿學校的宿舍。)
Avian maturation varies drastically; altricial nestlings require prolonged parental care compared to precocial species. (鳥類的成熟過程差異極大；與早熟性物種相比，晚熟性的雛鳥需要更長期的親代照顧。)
The small boat was completely swallowed by the dark, churning maw of the violent ocean whirlpool. (這艘小船完全被狂暴海洋漩渦那黑暗、翻湧的巨口所吞噬。)
The ancient Maya developed a highly sophisticated writing system and accurate astronomical calendars. (古馬雅人發展出了高度複雜的文字系統和精確的天文曆法。)
The historical palace gardens featured a complex hedge maze that entertained visitors for generations. (這座歷史悠久的宮殿花園設有複雜的樹籬迷宮，數代以來都是遊客的遊賞去處。)
The colony struggled during its initial year due to a meager agricultural harvest and freezing weather. (該殖民地在其第一年因微薄的農業收成和冰凍的天氣而陷入掙扎。)
The stream begins to meander gracefully through the valley, slowing its pace as it nears the ocean. (溪流開始優雅地蜿蜒流過山谷，在接近海洋時放慢了流速。)
Without systematic stratigraphic mapping, collecting fossilized bone fragments becomes scientifically meaningless. (在缺乏系統化地層繪圖的情況下，收集骨頭化石碎片在科學上變得毫無意義。)
The wild tubers gathered by Paleolithic forager groups were exceptionally meaty, delivering critical winter caloric foodstuffs. (舊石器時代採集者採集的野生塊莖肉質豐厚，是重要的冬季熱量來源。)
The mechanical reaper cuts wheat stubble mechanically, eliminating the slow, laborious manual threshing steps. (機械收割機以機械方式割下麥稈，省去緩慢費力的手工打穀步驟。)
The mechanization of threshing operations during the Industrial Revolution slashed agricultural labor demands extensively. (工業革命期間，打穀作業機械化大幅減少了農業勞動力需求。)
Nineteenth-century efforts to mechanize textile weaving vastly multiplied factory output while slashing labor costs. (十九世紀紡織業機械化的努力，大幅提高工廠產量並降低勞動成本。)
The localized geothermal energy installation generates over fifty megawatt units of clean electricity for the metropolis. (地方地熱發電設施為大都市提供超過五十百萬瓦的潔淨電力。)
Melanin is the biological pigment responsible for determining human skin, hair, and eye coloration. (黑色素是負責決定人類皮膚、頭髮和眼睛顏色的生物色素。)
The deep forest echoed with the melodious songs of diverse migratory bird species during early spring. (初春時節，茂密的森林裡迴盪著各種遷徙鳥類悅耳的歌聲。)

meaning: 核能反應爐核心熔毀、災難性的崩潰
example: Financial regulators implemented immediate safeguards to prevent a total systemic meltdown of the banking system. (金融監管機構實施了即刻的防範措施，以防止銀行系統發生完全的系統性崩潰。)
Seasonal meltwater from mountain peaks forms streams that sustain agricultural lowlands during dry summers. (山峰的季節性融水形成溪流，在乾燥的夏季滋養農業低地。)
The cell membrane controls the movement of substances in and out of the cell. (細胞膜控制物質進出細胞。)
Psychodynamic theorists study how adults mentally process repressed childhood memories. (心理動力學理論家研究成年人如何在心理上處理被壓抑的童年記憶。)
The growth of mercantile empires in Europe led to the establishment of global maritime trade networks. (歐洲商業帝國的擴張，促使全球海上貿易網逐漸形成。)
The desert environment is known for its merciless heat during the summer months. (沙漠環境以夏季酷熱無情而聞名。)
Fossils are not merely remnants of bones; they provide a comprehensive archive of ancient macroevolution. (化石不僅僅是骨頭的殘留物；它們提供了古代巨觀演化的完整檔案。)
The Prime Meridian, passing directly through Greenwich, England, serves as the international reference line for longitude. (穿越英國格林威治的本初子午線，是國際經度的參考線。)
The illusionist managed to mesmerize the entire auditorium with his intricate and seemingly impossible hand tricks. (魔術師以複雜且看似不可能的手部戲法，成功迷住全場觀眾。)

meaning: 美索不達米亞的；美索不達米亞人
example: Ancient Mesopotamian scribes developed cuneiform text systems, incising wedge stencils into wet mud tablets. (古代美索不達米亞書吏發展了楔形文字系統，並在濕泥板上刻下楔形文字。)
The Mesozoic era is often termed the 'Age of Reptiles' due to the ecological dominance of dinosaurs. (中生代因恐龍在生態上的主導地位，通常被稱為「爬蟲類時代」。)
The mesquite shrub thrives in semiarid lands by driving sinuous taproots deep into subsurface water tables. (這種豆科灌木在半乾燥地帶生長茂盛，靠蜿蜒的主根深入地下水位取水。)
Hibernation is characterized by a drastic drop in an animal's metabolic rate to conserve body energy. (冬眠的特徵是動物的新陳代謝率劇烈下降，以節省體能。)
Ectothermic animals have a low metabolic rate, adapting their metabolism directly to ambient temperatures. (外溫動物的新陳代謝率較低，會依環境溫度調節代謝。)
Ruminants harbor specialized intestinal microbes that actively metabolize rigid plant cellulose into digestible glucose starches. (反芻動物體內有特化的腸道微生物，能把堅韌的植物纖維素分解成可消化的葡萄糖。)
The development of advanced bronze metallurgy enabled ancient artisans to forge weapons of exceptional durability. (先進青銅冶金術的發展，使得古代工匠能夠鍛造出具備卓越耐久性的武器。)
The archaeological extraction uncovered highly refined Bronze Age metalwork, including ceremonial swords and studs. (考古挖掘發現了高度精緻的青銅時代金屬工藝製品，包括儀式用的劍與飾鈕。)
An expert Bronze Age metalworker melted mineral ores inside an airtight kiln to forge durable tools. (專業的青銅時代金屬工匠在密閉窯爐中熔化礦石，鍛造耐用工具。)
The philosopher's treatise delved into metaphysical questions regarding the fundamental nature of existence. (這位哲學家的論文深入探討了關於存在本質的形而上學問題。)
Most interplanetary particles vaporize completely as meteors in Earth's upper atmosphere before they can reach the ground. (大多數行星際物質尚未觸及地面，就已在進入地球高層大氣時化為流星並完全汽化。)
Geologists discovered a crater that preserves evidence of a catastrophic meteoric impact at the Cretaceous boundary. (地質學家發現了一個隕石坑，保存了白堊紀邊界發生毀滅性隕石撞擊的證據。)
Analysis of the meteorite revealed organic compounds that offer clues about the chemical composition of the early solar system. (對該隕石的分析發現了有機化合物，為早期太陽系的化學組成提供了線索。)
Chemical analysis of the crater matrix substantiated a high trace concentration of nickel minerals tied to a meteoritic explosion. (對隕石坑基質的化學分析，證實其中鎳的含量偏高，與隕石爆炸有關。)
An expert meteorologist analyzes dynamic airflow models to forecast if an onrushing storm will trigger flash floods downstream. (專業氣象學家分析氣流模型，預測來襲風暴是否會在下游引發暴洪。)
Methane is a potent greenhouse gas that traps atmospheric heat far more efficiently than carbon dioxide. (甲烷是一種強效的溫室氣體，其捕捉大氣熱量的效率遠高於二氧化碳。)
Methanol is commonly used as an industrial solvent and alternative fuel. (甲醇通常用作工業溶劑與替代燃料。)
The forensic scientists conducted a methodical search of the crime scene to ensure no trace evidence was overlooked. (法醫科學家對犯罪現場進行了有條不紊的搜查，以確保沒有遺漏任何微量證據。)
Organic chemists analyze how methyl compound components seep through porous sandstone layers, contaminating groundwater reserves. (有機化學家分析甲基化合物如何滲過多孔砂岩層，污染地下水層。)
The ancient metropolis boasted public aqueducts, amphitheaters, and sprawling commercial marketplaces. (這座古代大都市擁有公共高架水道、露天劇場和占地廣大的市集。)
The explorers struggled through the miasmic vapors of the dense, decomposing tropical marshlands. (探險家艱難穿越茂密、腐敗的熱帶沼澤，忍受其中瀰漫的瘴氣。)
Anaerobic microbial decomposition inside waterlogged wetlands generates significant volumes of volatile methane gas. (積水濕地中的厭氧微生物分解作用會產生大量甲烷氣體。)
A research microbiologist extracts DNA sequences from anaerobic bacteria thriving inside subsurface marine rifts. (一位研究型微生物學家從大量繁殖於海底裂谷深處的厭氧細菌中，提取 DNA 序列。)
Paleoecologists analyze marine microfossil remnants extracted from deep seafloor ooze strata to reconstruct ancient climatic cycles. (古生態學家分析從深海海床軟泥地層中提取的海洋微體化石殘留物，以重建古代的氣候週期。)
Each marine microorganism plays a critical ecological role by fixing nitrogen or decomposing organic wastes. (每種海洋微生物都透過固氮或分解有機廢棄物，發揮著關鍵的生態作用。)
Microscopic analysis of the ancient pottery shards revealed traces of lipids from dairy products. (對古代陶器碎片的顯微分析顯示出了來自乳製品的脂質痕跡。)
The predatory peregrine falcon intercepts its flying avian prey in midair with high-velocity diving accuracy. (捕食性的遊隼以精準的高速俯衝，在半空中攔截飛行中的鳥類獵物。)
The midcontinent tectonic fault line remains largely dormant, experiencing rare and minor seismic adjustments. (大陸中部的板塊斷層線大多處於休眠狀態，只有罕見且輕微的地震活動。)
Buying directly from the farmers eliminates the cost of the middleman. (直接向農民購買可以省去中間人的成本。)
She spent the entire week studying for her chemistry midterm. (她花了一整週的時間在準備化學期中考。)
The American Midwest became a global agricultural mainstay due to its flat terrain and fertile topsoil. (美國中西部因其平坦的地形與肥沃的表土，成為全球農業的支柱。)
The midwestern agricultural belt produces a significant percentage of the global supply of corn and soybeans. (美國中西部農業帶生產了全球供應中極高比例的玉米和大豆。)
Migratory birds navigate thousands of miles each year using Earth's magnetic field and celestial cues. (候鳥每年利用地球磁場和天象徵候，遷徙數千英里。)
The novelist's writing style was deeply shaped by the artistic and political milieu of early 20th-century Paris. (這名小說家的寫作風格深受20世紀初巴黎藝術與政治環境的形塑。)
The centralized chiefdom empire was militarily dominant, erecting massive fieldstone wall fortifications around its peripheral seports. (中央集權的酋邦帝國在軍事上佔優勢，在其外圍海港四周築起巨大的粗石防禦牆。)
Centralized chiefdom confederacies often developed hierarchical, militaristic organizations to defend peripheral trade outposts. (中央集權的酋邦聯盟通常會發展出階級化的、軍事主義的組織，以保衛外圍的貿易據點。)
The street performer used expressive body language and mime to captivate the diverse crowd of tourists. (這位街頭藝人利用富有表現力的肢體語言和默劇，吸引了形形色色的觀光客群。)
Soil mineralization converts organic nitrogen into inorganic forms like nitrates that can be absorbed by plant roots. (土壤礦化作用將有機氮轉化為無機形式（如硝酸鹽），以便被植物根部吸收。)
Symbiotic microbes inside topsoil break down fallen foliage, acting to mineralize organic nitrogen into absorbable nitrates. (表土內部的共生微生物分解落葉，起到將有機氮礦化為可吸收硝酸鹽的作用。)

meaning: 極簡主義的；極簡主義者
example: The modernist choreographer favored minimalist set designs, ensuring the audience focused wholly on naturalistic gestures. (這位現代主義編舞家青睞極簡主義的舞台設計，確保觀眾完全專注於寫實的身體姿態。)
The traveling minstrel played an affordable handcraft lute, transmitting oral folkloric epics across preindustrial towns. (巡迴吟遊詩人彈奏平價的手工魯特琴，在工業化前的城鎮間傳唱民間史詩。)
Even a minuscule trace fluctuation in ocean salinity can disrupt the delicate metabolic balance of marine plankton. (即使海洋鹽度出現極微小的波動，也會破壞海洋浮游生物脆弱的新陳代謝平衡。)
The intense heat rising from the asphalt created a mirage that made the dry highway appear flooded. (從瀝青路面升起的酷熱產生了海市蜃樓，使乾燥的公路看起來像是被水淹沒了一樣。)
Linguists warn that without direct referent identifiers, scholars can easily misinterpret abstract cuneiform symbol inscriptions. (語言學家警告，若缺少直接指示物的識別標記，學者很容易誤讀抽象的楔形文字銘文。)
The previous executive team managed to mismanage the company's funds. (前高管團隊對公司的資金管理不善。)
An ecological mismatch occurs when migratory birds hatch after peak forest insect decomposition has already passed. (如果候鳥孵化時間晚於森林昆蟲數量高峰，就會造成生態失配。)
The linguistic research focused on the semantic functions of modal verbs across different European languages. (這項語言學研究聚焦於不同歐洲語言中情態動詞的語義功能。)
Computer modeling helps meteorologists predict the path of severe hurricanes. (電腦建模有助於氣象學家預測嚴重颶風的路徑。)
The corporate headquarters featured a modernistic aesthetic defined by clean lines, glass walls, and open layouts. (公司總部呈現出以俐落線條、玻璃牆和開放式格局為特色的現代主義美學。)
The architectural design seamlessly blended traditional cultural motifs with elements of sleek, industrial modernity. (這項建築設計將傳統文化圖騰與俐落的工業現代感融為一體。)
The industrial engineer designed a standardized mechanical weaving module to expedite component replacement inside spinning mills. (工業工程師設計了一個標準化的機械編織模組，以加快紡紗廠內部的部件更換速度。)
The two competing nations established a pragmatic diplomatic modus vivendi to avoid open military conflict. (這兩個競爭國家建立了一種務實的外交相處模式，以避免公開的軍事衝突。)
Nineteenth-century commercial shipping farers transported heavy barrels of sugarcane molasses across lucrative maritime trade routes. (十九世紀的商業航海家跨越獲利豐厚的海上貿易路線，運輸沉重的甘蔗糖蜜桶。)
Modern evolutionary science utilizes molecular analysis of DNA sequences to re-map ancient species deviations. (現代演化科學利用 DNA 序列的分子分析，重新描繪古代物種的分化。)
Arthropods must periodically molt their rigid exoskeletons to accommodate physical growth. (節肢動物必須定期脫去其僵硬的外骨骼，以適應身體的生長。)
Volcanologists collected samples of molten rock as it slowly flowed down the active volcano's slopes. (火山學家在熔岩緩慢流下活火山山坡時採集了岩漿樣本。)
The structural attainment of powered flight by pterosaurs represented a momentous milestone in vertebrate evolutionary prehistory. (翼龍成功演化出動力飛行，是脊椎動物演化史上的重大里程碑。)
The historical monastery, built high in the remote mountains, houses a collection of ancient religious scrolls. (這座建在偏遠高山上的歷史修道院，收藏了一系列古代宗教卷軸。)
The nineteenth-century printmaking artisan generated detailed monochrome lithograph profiles capturing industrial factory scenes. (十九世紀版畫工匠製作細緻的單色石版畫人物側面像，描繪工業工廠景象。)

meaning: 一夫一妻制的；單配偶制的
example: Ethological studies show that certain migratory bird species maintain strictly monogamous mating systems during nesting. (動物行為學研究顯示，某些遷徙鳥類在築巢期間維持嚴格的一夫一妻制。)
During early industrialization, a few mercantile corporate networks worked legally to monopolize intercity railway transit systems. (工業化初期，少數商業集團以合法手段壟斷城際鐵路運輸系統。)
Incomplete thermal fuel combustion inside preindustrial steam engines releases harmful carbon monoxide gas into urban arcades. (工業化前的蒸汽機燃料若燃燒不完全，會向城市拱廊釋放有害的一氧化碳。)

meaning: 紀念碑式的；不朽的；宏偉的
example: The construction of monumental architecture like pyramids required centralized political authority and vast labor. (像金字塔這類宏偉建築的建造，需要集中的政治權力和龐大的勞動力。)
A terminal moraine is a ridge of coarse rock debris deposited at the furthest edge of a moving glacier. (終冰磧是在移動冰河的最遠邊緣沉積的粗糙岩石碎屑脊。)
The political essay analyzed the tension between pragmatic realpolitik and abstract moralism in foreign affairs. (這篇政治文章分析了外交事務中務實的現實政治與抽象道德主義之間的緊張關係。)
The literature critic dismissed the novel as excessively moralistic, arguing that it sacrificed character depth for a sermon. (文學評論家認為這部小說說教意味太濃，為了道德訓誡而犧牲了角色深度。)
The Puritanical sect regarded the commercialism of the metropolitan elite as morally bankrupt. (這個清教徒派別認為大都市菁英的重商主義在道德上已經敗壞。)
The bodies of the victims were taken to the local morgue for identification. (受害者的遺體被送往當地的太平間以辨識身分。)
The researchers studied the historical patterns of Mormon migration to the Salt Lake Valley in the mid-19th century. (研究人員研究了19世紀中期摩門教徒遷移至鹽湖谷的歷史模式。)
William Morris spearheaded the Arts and Crafts movement, rejecting the rigid unadorned simplification of mass industrialism. (威廉·莫里斯帶頭發起了工藝美術運動，拒絕大規模工業化僵硬、無裝飾的簡化形式。)
Improved healthcare has contributed to a significant decline in infant mortality. (醫療保健的改善有助於嬰兒死亡率的顯著下降。)
The embarrassing mistake managed to mortify him in front of his colleagues. (這個尷尬的錯誤讓他在同事面前感到非常羞愧。)
Expert joiners engineered Pullman sleeping car woodworks using stable mortise and tenon links without metal screws. (專業的細木工匠以穩固的榫眼與榫頭接合，製作出普爾曼臥鋪車廂的木作，全程不用金屬螺絲。)
The archaeological excavation revealed a beautifully preserved mosaic floor depicting ancient maritime trade routes. (這項考古挖掘揭示了一個保存精美的馬賽克地板，描繪了古代的海上貿易路線。)

Through her pioneering work in primatology, Jane Goodall revolutionized our understanding of chimpanzee behavior. (透過在靈長類動物學方面的開創性研究，珍古德徹底改變了我們對黑猩猩行為的理解。)
Primitive stony chondrites offer researchers a pristine sample of Earth's primordial planetary building blocks. (原始的石質球粒隕石為研究人員提供了地球形成時行星構成基礎材料的純淨樣本。)
The ecological diet of the coastal bird population consists principally of small fish caught near the marine seabed surface. (沿海鳥類的主要食物是牠們在海床附近捕捉的小魚。)
The evolution of woodcut printmaking permitted publishers to mass-produce complex visual blueprints alongside text inscriptions. (木刻版畫技術的發展，讓出版商能大量複製複雜圖像與文字銘文。)

An independent pioneer prospector mapped out the southwestern desert, searching for potash and manganese veins. (一位獨立的拓荒探礦者勘測西南部沙漠，尋找碳酸鉀與錳礦脈。)

meaning: 平臥的；（植物）伏地的；倒下的

In classical literature, the protagonist frequently undergoes a transformative psychological journey. (在古典文學中，主角經常經歷一場轉變性的心理歷程。)

meaning: 保護主義的；保護主義者

The predatory osprey relies on sharp, curved talons to puncture the tough scales of marine fish caught near seabed surfaces. (捕食性的魚鷹依靠銳利彎曲的趾爪，刺穿牠在海床附近捕獲的海魚堅硬鱗片。)
The municipal water infrastructure relies on continuous chemical purification to remove industrial toxic runoff. (市政供水設施仰賴持續的化學淨化，清除工業有毒逕流。)
The puritan religious sect rejected the mercantile commercialism and theatrical entertainment of the metropolis. (清教徒派別拒絕大都市的重商主義與劇場娛樂。)

meaning: 清教徒式的；道德極嚴格的
